summary: First-time invitees to an organization receive organizer_account_id NULL from accept_org_invite because no RLS policy lets a brand-new member read the org's non-public organizer_accounts row. This was surfaced by the ORG-003/ORG-004 live RLS probe passes (P1-P9 green) and is non-blocking for local readiness (P2), but needs a product/security decision before implementation: grant a security-definer read helper inside accept_org_invite (returns the org id to the inviter's result only) versus adding a new-member organizer_accounts visibility policy. The organization agent will implement the chosen approach as an additive migration under CP-051 manual-apply and re-probe P1-P9.
